Name: Where's My Horse
Author: temisthem
Description:
[b][size=4]Press 'C' (keybind is configurable) to display a bubble over your horse's head!

Find your horse whether it's hiding in a field of cows, or behind a tree!

*I am not responsible for anything if you still can't find your horse
[/size][/b]
[size=3]Yesterday I got sick and tired of not being able to find my horse, so here this is.

[b][size=6]Requirements:[/size]
[/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)

[size=6][b]Mod Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
Compatible with basically anything and everything.

Yes, that includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url]! Goldenrevolver from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url] helped out to make this mod detect whether or not 'thin horse' is enabled and automatically adjust the offset X to match!

[size=6][b]Multiplayer Compatibility:
[/b][/size]
If you don't want to see the emote appear for horses other than your own, you can check the "Only my horse" option in the config settings.

[b][size=6]Configuration:[/size]
[/b]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
Customizable settings include:
- Keybinding
- Disabling emote on mounting 
- Disabling emote on changing map
- Always displaying emote (except when riding)
- Displaying emote on top of everything except for menus
- Displaying emote ONLY for your horse 
- Bubble size, opacity, and offsets 
[/size]
